facts.statement: Tuesday TipsDay is a new weekly series on the official forums and site where veteran players share tips and tricks.
facts.quote: Time for a new weekly series: Tuesday TipsDay

article_summaries.title: Tuesday TipsDay - February 19, 2013
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community post launching the weekly 'Tuesday TipsDay' series, sharing a player tip from Karen Souldancer. The tip says Sarkin Stonehearth's daily quest is a fast way to collect top-tier Sunstone rewards, using the shortcut, potions, and a Brawler or Archer class setup.
